subject.title: docs(release): add a release-train scope contract

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this exact release-train issue, six-class taxonomy, and exception grammar as mandatory policy now, or pilot it as advisory until a complete shadow train is reviewed?
rationale: Source inspection can assess consistency, but only release owners can accept the permanent governance burden and decide when staged audit evidence is sufficient to make the contract authoritative.

options.title: Pilot as advisory
options.body: Use the template for one complete shadow train, capture redacted operational evidence, and promote the final vocabulary only after release-owner review.

options.title: Adopt immediately
options.body: Approve the mandatory contract now while explicitly accepting that initial trains rely on manual interpretation until the companion audit stages land.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep existing release guidance unchanged until the companion audit, report publishing, and shadow-train evidence are ready together.

recommendation.title: Pilot as advisory
recommendation.body: Use the template for one complete shadow train, capture redacted operational evidence, and promote the final vocabulary only after release-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The release-reference history and central release-policy changes make this the strongest available owner for accepting a new mandatory release governance contract.
